gen-fs-bevellier-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Graceful and stencil-cut, Bevellier packs its glyphs tight and keeps every stroke at a single weight, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed rolls in. Bevellier is the showpiece; the plain sans is the workhorse.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads like rod stock, big-bodied and open. Bevellier takes the stage above it with a flat, stencil-cut swagger, and the two settle into a clear division of labor.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-stack-sans-text: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly packed, Bevellier sets a graceful tone, then Stack Sans Text follows with a marker-like line in big lowercase. Their strongest quality is the contrast in spacing.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-sulphur-point: Stencil-cut and graceful, packed close. Bevellier holds one stroke weight throughout, while Sulphur Point answers with bulky lowercase and gaps you can plainly see in its a and s.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-tiktok-sans: Bevellier's stencil-cut strokes, all drawn at one weight and crowded tight together, give it a graceful, flat look. And TikTok Sans, with its tall x-height, can stay modest in size without losing its footing.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-ubuntu-sans: Stencil-flat and sleek, with a graceful hush. Bevellier crowds its glyphs close, and Ubuntu Sans loosens things with bent-pipe strokes and big lowercase eyes, a plain sans that opens up everything.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-vend-sans: Bevellier's flat, stencil-cut strokes and tightly packed glyphs make it unmistakable at the top of a page. And Vend Sans fills the line with ruler-straight strokes and open curves, which keeps the pair distinct.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-yaldevi: Flat, stencil-cut and gracefully tight, Bevellier leads the way. Yaldevi follows in a plain sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly, so a long passage reads softly.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-inter-tight: Chubbo looks drawn with a marker tip, its curves gliding around each bend without a snag. Inter Tight settles into a steady, modern sans with short ascenders.
gen-fs-comico-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code brings a wire-like monoline skeleton and a smooth path around each bend, while Comico stacks its lowercase like poured lead. Their strongest quality is spacing that never hides.
